description: This file defines a FastAPI application with an endpoint that schedules background tasks to write logs to a file.

methods.name: write_log(message: str)
methods.description: Writes a message to the log.txt file asynchronously triggered as a background task.

methods.name: get_query(background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: Union[str, None] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves query parameter q and schedules a background task to log it.

methods.name: send_notification( email: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: str = Depends(get_query) )
methods.description: FastAPI route handler that sends a notification and schedules log writing in the background.

ctags.name: get_query
ctags.pattern: /^def get_query(background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: Union[str, None] = None):$/

ctags.name: send_notification
ctags.signature: ( email: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, q: str = Depends(get_query) )
